President Bola Tinubu has once again promised Nigerians reliable electricity, raising fresh expectations in a country where frequent power outages continue to disrupt businesses, affect household activities and increase the cost of living.
NIGERIA DAILY: How Credible Is Nigeria’s Register Ahead of 2027?
Despite successive government promises, billions of naira in financial interventions and several reforms in the power sector, stable electricity remains a major challenge. Many businesses continue to depend on generators, while millions of electricity consumers are still without prepaid meters.
NIGERIA DAILY: How Credible Is Nigeria’s Register Ahead of 2027?
With huge financial commitments to the sector, questions remain about why Nigerians are yet to enjoy consistent electricity, what is standing in the way of progress and whether the current efforts will finally deliver the expected results.
Today on Nigeria Daily, we examine why reliable electricity remains a promise in Nigeria, the challenges confronting the power sector and what needs to change.
